text.hi: दो वाक्यों में एक ही इंसान हो, तो उन्हें ‘who’ से जोड़ सकते हैं। ‘who’ का मतलब है ‘जो’। The girl is Sarita. The girl is wearing a red sweater. → The girl who is wearing a red sweater is Sarita.
text.hinglish: Do vaakyon mein ek hi insaan ho, to unhe ‘who’ se jod sakte hain. ‘who’ ka matlab hai ‘jo’. The girl is Sarita. The girl is wearing a red sweater. → The girl who is wearing a red sweater is Sarita.
text.en: When two sentences are about the same person, join them with ‘who’. The girl is Sarita. The girl is wearing a red sweater. → The girl who is wearing a red sweater is Sarita.

text.hi: याद रखो: ‘who’ लोगों के लिए है। जानवरों और चीज़ों के लिए ‘which’ लगाते हैं: The dog which barks is mine.
text.hinglish: Yaad rakho: ‘who’ logon ke liye hai. Jaanwaron aur cheezon ke liye ‘which’ lagaate hain: The dog which barks is mine.
text.en: Remember: ‘who’ is for people. For animals and things we use ‘which’: The dog which barks is mine.

prompt.hi: जोड़ो: The boy is wearing a blue cap. + The boy is the tallest boy in the class.
prompt.hinglish: Jodo: The boy is wearing a blue cap. + The boy is the tallest boy in the class.
prompt.en: Join: The boy is wearing a blue cap. + He is the tallest boy in the class.

steps.answer: The boy who is wearing a blue cap is the tallest boy in the class.

meaning.hi: जो लड़का नीली टोपी पहने है, वह क्लास का सबसे लंबा लड़का है।
meaning.hinglish: Jo ladka neeli topi pehne hai, woh class ka sabse lamba ladka hai.

prompt.hi: जोड़ो: Seema studies in class VIII. + Seema is the most brilliant student of the class.
prompt.hinglish: Jodo: Seema studies in class VIII. + Seema is the most brilliant student of the class.
prompt.en: Join the two sentences about Seema.

steps.answer: Seema, who studies in class VIII, is the most brilliant student of the class.

meaning.hi: सीमा, जो आठवीं कक्षा में पढ़ती है, क्लास की सबसे होशियार छात्रा है।
meaning.hinglish: Seema, jo aathvi kaksha mein padhti hai, class ki sabse hoshiyaar chhaatra hai.

prompt.hi: जोड़ो: John is a good story teller. + John is telling an interesting story.
prompt.hinglish: Jodo: John is a good story teller. + John is telling an interesting story.
prompt.en: Join the two sentences about John.

steps.answer: John, who is a good story teller, is telling an interesting story.

meaning.hi: जॉन, जो अच्छा कहानी सुनाने वाला है, एक मज़ेदार कहानी सुना रहा है।
meaning.hinglish: John, jo achha kahani sunaane waala hai, ek mazedaar kahani suna raha hai.

prompt.hi: जोड़ो: Gurmeet helps the boy. + The boy is blind.
prompt.hinglish: Jodo: Gurmeet helps the boy. + The boy is blind.
prompt.en: Join: Gurmeet helps the boy. + The boy is blind.

steps.answer: Gurmeet helps the boy who is blind.

meaning.hi: गुरमीत उस लड़के की मदद करता है जो देख नहीं सकता।
meaning.hinglish: Gurmeet us ladke ki madad karta hai jo dekh nahi sakta.

meaning.hi: जो आदमी आम बेचता है, वह मेरे चाचा हैं।
meaning.hinglish: Jo aadmi aam bechta hai, woh mere chacha hain.

steps.sentence: The dog ___ barks at night is very old.

meaning.hi: जो कुत्ता रात को भौंकता है, वह बहुत बूढ़ा है।
meaning.hinglish: Jo kutta raat ko bhaunkta hai, woh bahut boodha hai.

steps.sentence: I know a girl ___ can sing very well.

meaning.hi: मैं एक लड़की को जानता/जानती हूँ जो बहुत अच्छा गाती है।
meaning.hinglish: Main ek ladki ko jaanta/jaanti hoon jo bahut achha gaati hai.
